notes.title: Little Control Update
notes.content:
Hi ! I have made an update for the game.
Now, you can remapping the keys when you play on mouse/keyboard.
You can switch between controller / keyboard(+mouse) by plug/unplug controller.
Add Camera sensivity when you play on keyboard.
New "Water effect" in game.

I hope you'll like it.

Oh, Badges, Background, Emoticons and Trading Cards coming very soon!

Cheers!
